$description: Token names on their way out. A name listed here is still emitted, still works, and still appears in the published manifest, marked so a consumer can see it coming. That is what the deprecation window is: the name keeps working for at least one minor release after it is announced, so nothing breaks the moment a rename is decided. Add an entry the release a rename is decided, not the release it lands. Removing a name means deleting its entry here and its token in the same change, and the contract check refuses that unless the previous release had already announced it.

$schema.replacement: The token to move to. Omit when nothing takes the old name's job.
$schema.since: The released version that announced the deprecation.
$schema.reason: Why the name is going, in a sentence a plugin author can act on.
